g.text: RNA gene-regulatory network inference • RustScenic 0.5.0 • 10x E18 mouse brain
B–C: matched 20,000-cell input, 2,095 genes, 256 TFs, 16 workers.
Memory comparison: Intel node only; one observation per node.

g.text: Scope: GRN computation, not the full workflow. Separate 1.3M-cell preparation: 7m18s, 71.5 GB peak.
Early stopping enabled (5,000-tree ceiling). Comparisons exclude file loading and reference dense conversion.
Recorded 28 Aug 2026 on IFB; individual observations, not repeated-run averages. These results do not establish biological superiority.
